items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: That was Charlie McCurtis. I guess you heard of that, didn't you?

ctx.x: Loud. Was that triple tone? Could he do triple tone?

Yeah, he could do triple tone. Buddy Bolton. Yeah. He was a cracker jack in that day. And loud, and loud with it. James McNeil was the greatest. James McNeil was the best musician, trumpet player that we ever turned out in New Orleans. I guess you know of him, don't you? James McNeil. He was the master. James McNeil. He was better than Manuel Perez. Manuel was one of the biggest fellow sheriff. Another man was a cracker jack, a musician. He did something. I never saw him do it. But it's been proven by other…
